- "拐卖妇女" (human trafficking) maybe "拐卖妇女、儿童罪". He bought a woman who was kidnapped? The fact says "被拐骗的已婚妇女" meaning she was abducted. He purchased her. That is "拐卖妇女罪" (trafficking of women). Under Chinese law, "组织、利用、买卖人口" etc. So crime: "拐卖妇女罪".

- "强奸罪" maybe because he had sexual relations with a mentally disabled woman who cannot consent. - "非法拘禁罪"? He kept her as wife, but she left voluntarily. Not necessarily illegal detention. He bought her and kept her, maybe "非法拘禁" but she left. Not clear.

- "买卖人口罪" is "买卖人口罪" (trafficking). The act of buying a trafficked woman is "买卖人口罪". The law: "买卖人口罪" includes buying, selling, transporting, etc. So "买卖人口罪" is appropriate.

- "强奸罪" is appropriate.

Thus list: "买卖人口罪;强奸罪". In Chinese official naming: "买卖人口罪" (or "拐卖妇女罪"?). The law distinguishes "拐卖妇女、儿童罪" (Article 236). Since the victim is a woman, "拐卖妇女罪". The defendant is buyer, not trafficker? The law says "买卖人口" includes buying. So "拐卖妇女罪" maybe more precise. Use "拐卖妇女罪". Also "强奸罪". So answer: [罪名]拐卖妇女罪;强奸罪<eoa>
